title: RADAR-Q: Resource-Aware Distributed Asynchronous Routing for Entanglement Distribution in Multi-Tenant Quantum Networks
summary: Scalable quantum networks must support concurrent entanglement requests, yet existing routing protocols fail when users compete for shared repeater resources, wasting fragile quantum states. This paper presents RADAR-Q, a resource-aware decentralized routing protocol embedding real-time resource contention into path selection. Unlike prior designs requiring global coordination or central anchors, RADAR-Q makes intelligent local decisions balancing path length and fidelity, instantaneous quantum memory availability, and intermediate Bell-State Measurement (BSM) operations.
